name: Public Community and Social Sentiment Mining
phase: Customer Discovery and Problem Validation Tactics
hypothesis: We believe that users of [incumbent software] are actively seeking alternatives due to [specific systemic flaw]. We will verify this by analyzing 300 unresolved negative comments and support threads across industry forums, and consider it validated if ≥ 25% of organic complaint threads focus specifically on [flaw].

plan.label: Preparation
plan.text: Map the practitioner communities: specialist forums, issue trackers, subreddits and professional groups.

plan.label: Execution
plan.text: Search with diagnostic boolean strings - how do I fix, alternative to, terrible UX, workaround.

plan.label: Data collection
plan.text: Group complaints into themes, reported losses and the operational driver under each.

planFull.label: Preparation
planFull.text: Map primary practitioner communities across specialized forums, GitHub issue trackers, subreddit channels, and professional discussion spaces.

planFull.label: Execution
planFull.text: Execute systematic diagnostic search queries using boolean strings (e.g., "how do I fix", "alternative to", "terrible UX", "workaround").

planFull.label: Data collection
planFull.text: Aggregate complaint structures into an analysis matrix. Track recurring themes, estimated financial losses reported by users, and underlying operational drivers.

warning.label: Selection Bias of Vocal Minorities
warning.text: Public threads amplify edge-case power users whose needs diverge from the mainstream market.

warningFull: Public communities amplify the grievances of highly vocal edge-case power users whose requirements diverge significantly from the mainstream market.
